page.overview:
Who is Agent Swift?

Lego Agents (stylized as LEGO Agents) is a discontinued Lego theme that was first introduced in June 2008 after the discontinued Lego Alpha Team theme. The theme was inspired by James Bond as well as various spy movies.

The 13 toy sets in the theme's release were split into three waves. 0. It was discontinued by the end of 2009 and replaced with the Lego Ultra Agents theme in 2014.

entity.description: Lego Agents (stylized as LEGO Agents) is a discontinued Lego theme that was first introduced in June 2008 after the discontinued Lego Alpha Team theme. The theme was inspired by James Bond as well as various spy movies. The 13 toy sets in the theme's release were split into three waves. In 2009, the theme was re-branded as Lego Agents 2.0. It was discontinued by the end of 2009 and replaced with the Lego Ultra Agents theme in 2014.
